```{python}
#| echo: false

import os
import json
import pandas as pd
from IPython.display import Markdown, display

# Read raw_dir from environment variable (set by generate_report.sh).
raw_dir = os.environ.get('SECURITY_RAW_DIR', "reports/raw")

def fmt_blue(text):
    fmt = os.environ.get('QUARTO_FORMAT', 'html')
    if fmt in ['latex', 'pdf']:
        esc_text = text.replace('&', '\\&')
        return f"\\textcolor[rgb]{{0,0.3,0.6}}{{\\textbf{{{esc_text}}}}}"
    else:
        return f"<span style='color:#0056b3; font-weight:bold;'>{text}</span>"

def fmt_status(status_val):
    if not status_val:
        return status_val
    fmt = os.environ.get('QUARTO_FORMAT', 'html')
    status_str = str(status_val)
    status_upper = status_str.upper()
    
    if fmt in ['latex', 'pdf']:
        if "PASS" in status_upper:
            return f"\\textcolor[rgb]{{0,0.5,0}}{{\\textbf{{{status_str}}}}}"
        elif "FAIL" in status_upper:
            return f"\\textcolor[rgb]{{0.8,0,0}}{{\\textbf{{{status_str}}}}}"
        elif "WARN" in status_upper:
            return f"\\textcolor[rgb]{{0.8,0.5,0}}{{\\textbf{{{status_str}}}}}"
        else: # Skipped / Not Run
            return f"\\textcolor[rgb]{{0.5,0.5,0.5}}{{\\textbf{{{status_str}}}}}"
    else:
        if "PASS" in status_upper:
            return f"<span style='color:#2e7d32; font-weight:bold;'>{status_str}</span>"
        elif "FAIL" in status_upper:
            return f"<span style='color:#d32f2f; font-weight:bold;'>{status_str}</span>"
        elif "WARN" in status_upper:
            return f"<span style='color:#f57c00; font-weight:bold;'>{status_str}</span>"
        else: # Skipped / Not Run
            return f"<span style='color:#757575; font-weight:bold;'>{status_str}</span>"

def generate_report_fingerprint(r_dir):
    try:
        import hashlib
        import glob
        # Find all json and txt files in raw_dir
        files = sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(r_dir, "*")))
        hasher = hashlib.sha256()
        for fpath in files:
            if os.path.isfile(fpath) and not fpath.endswith('report.html'):
                # Hash the file content
                with open(fpath, 'rb') as f:
                    hasher.update(f.read())
        return hasher.hexdigest()
    except Exception:
        return "N/A"

def format_word_breaks(s, is_code=True):
    if not s:
        return s
    import re
    res = str(s)
    fmt = os.environ.get('QUARTO_FORMAT', 'html')
    if fmt in ['latex', 'pdf']:
        # Escape LaTeX special characters
        res = res.replace('\\', '\\textbackslash ')
        res = res.replace('~', '\\textasciitilde{}')
        res = res.replace('$', '\\$')
        res = res.replace('%', '\\%')
        res = res.replace('#', '\\#')
        res = res.replace('{', '\\{')
        res = res.replace('}', '\\}')
        res = res.replace('&', '\\&')
        res = res.replace('_', '\\_')
        
        # If we explicitly allow breaks (printed outside markdown backticks)
        if not is_code:
            res = res.replace('/', '/\\allowbreak ')
            res = res.replace('-', '-\\allowbreak ')
            res = res.replace('.', '.\\allowbreak ')
            res = res.replace('@', '@\\allowbreak ')
            res = res.replace(':', ':\\allowbreak ')
            res = res.replace('\\_', '\\_\\allowbreak ')
            
        return res
    else:
        res = res.replace('_', '_ ')
        res = res.replace(':', ' : ')
        res = res.replace('/', ' / ')
        res = res.replace('@', ' @ ')
        res = res.replace('--', ' -- ')
        res = re.sub(r'([a-zA-Z])-([a-zA-Z])', r'\1- \2', res)
        return res


def get_tool_version(tool_name):
    import subprocess
    import re
    
    # Static fallbacks (from Dockerfile defaults) in case execution fails or command not found
    fallbacks = {
        'gitleaks': 'v8.18.2',
        'trivy': 'v0.55.0',
        'snyk': 'Latest',
        'docker-scout': 'Latest',
        'syft': 'v1.20.0',
        'grype': 'v0.88.0',
        'cosign': 'v3.0.6',
        'semgrep': 'v1.160.0',
        'bandit': 'v1.7.5',
        'flake8': 'v6.0.0',
        'black': 'v24.0.0',
        'lintr': 'v3.1.2',
        'oysteR': 'v0.1.1',
        'riskmetric': 'v0.2.4',
        'nf-core': 'v2.14'
    }
    
    try:
        if tool_name == 'gitleaks':
            res = subprocess.run(['gitleaks', 'version'], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=5)
            v = res.stdout.strip()
            if re.search(r'\d+\.\d+\.\d+', v):
                return v if v.startswith('v') else f"v{v}"
        elif tool_name == 'trivy':
            res = subprocess.run(['trivy', '--version'], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=5)
            m = re.search(r'Version:\s*(\d+\.\d+\.\d+)', res.stdout)
            if m: return f"v{m.group(1)}"
        elif tool_name == 'snyk':
            res = subprocess.run(['snyk', '--version'], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=5)
            m = re.search(r'(\d+\.\d+\.\d+)', res.stdout)
            if m: return f"v{m.group(1)}"
        elif tool_name == 'docker-scout':
            res = subprocess.run(['docker-scout', 'version'], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=5)
            m = re.search(r'version\s+(\d+\.\d+\.\d+)', res.stdout)
            if m: return f"v{m.group(1)}"
            res = subprocess.run(['docker-scout', '--version'], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=5)
            m = re.search(r'version\s+(\d+\.\d+\.\d+)', res.stdout)
            if m: return f"v{m.group(1)}"
        elif tool_name == 'syft':
            res = subprocess.run(['syft', '--version'], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=5)
            m = re.search(r'(\d+\.\d+\.\d+)', res.stdout)
            if m: return f"v{m.group(1)}"
        elif tool_name == 'grype':
            res = subprocess.run(['grype', '--version'], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=5)
            m = re.search(r'(\d+\.\d+\.\d+)', res.stdout)
            if m: return f"v{m.group(1)}"
        elif tool_name == 'cosign':
            res = subprocess.run(['cosign', 'version'], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=5)
            m = re.search(r'GitVersion:\s*v?(\d+\.\d+\.\d+)', res.stdout)
            if m: return f"v{m.group(1)}"
            m = re.search(r'(\d+\.\d+\.\d+)', res.stdout)
            if m: return f"v{m.group(1)}"
        elif tool_name == 'semgrep':
            res = subprocess.run(['semgrep', '--version'], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=5)
            v = res.stdout.strip()
            if re.search(r'\d+\.\d+\.\d+', v):
                return f"v{v}"
        elif tool_name == 'bandit':
            res = subprocess.run(['bandit', '--version'], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=5)
            out = res.stdout + res.stderr
            m = re.search(r'(\d+\.\d+\.\d+)', out)
            if m: return f"v{m.group(1)}"
        elif tool_name == 'flake8':
            res = subprocess.run(['flake8', '--version'], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=5)
            m = re.search(r'^(\d+\.\d+\.\d+)', res.stdout.strip())
            if m: return f"v{m.group(1)}"
        elif tool_name == 'black':
            res = subprocess.run(['black', '--version'], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=5)
            m = re.search(r'black,\s*v?(\d+\.\d+\.\d+)', res.stdout)
            if m: return f"v{m.group(1)}"
            m = re.search(r'(\d+\.\d+\.\d+)', res.stdout)
            if m: return f"v{m.group(1)}"
        elif tool_name == 'lintr':
            res = subprocess.run(['Rscript', '-e', 'cat(as.character(packageVersion("lintr")))'], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=5)
            v = res.stdout.strip()
            if re.search(r'\d+\.\d+\.\d+', v):
                return f"v{v}"
        elif tool_name == 'oysteR':
            res = subprocess.run(['Rscript', '-e', 'cat(as.character(packageVersion("oysteR")))'], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=5)
            v = res.stdout.strip()
            if re.search(r'\d+\.\d+\.\d+', v):
                return f"v{v}"
        elif tool_name == 'riskmetric':
            res = subprocess.run(['Rscript', '-e', 'cat(as.character(packageVersion("riskmetric")))'], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=5)
            v = res.stdout.strip()
            if re.search(r'\d+\.\d+\.\d+', v):
                return f"v{v}"
        elif tool_name == 'nf-core':
            res = subprocess.run(['nf-core', '--version'], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=5)
            m = re.search(r'version\s+(\d+\.\d+\.\d+)', res.stdout)
            if m: return f"v{m.group(1)}"
            m = re.search(r'(\d+\.\d+\.\d+)', res.stdout)
            if m: return f"v{m.group(1)}"
    except Exception:
        pass
    
    return fallbacks.get(tool_name, 'Unknown')


def parse_sarif_docker_scout(path):
    """
    Parses a SARIF JSON file from docker-scout and returns counts of Critical and High severity vulnerabilities.
    """
    counts = {'C': 0, 'H': 0, 'M': 0, 'L': 0}
    try:
        with open(path, 'r') as f:
            sarif = json.load(f)
        
        rules_map = {}
        for run in sarif.get('runs', []):
            driver = run.get('tool', {}).get('driver', {})
            for rule in driver.get('rules', []):
                rule_id = rule.get('id')
                if rule_id:
                    rules_map[rule_id] = rule
            
            for res in run.get('results', []):
                rule_id = res.get('ruleId')
                rule = rules_map.get(rule_id, {}) if rule_id else {}
                
                severity = None
                tags = rule.get('properties', {}).get('tags', [])
                for t in tags:
                    if 'severity:' in t.lower():
                        parts = t.split(':')
                        if len(parts) > 1:
                            severity = parts[1].strip().upper()
                            break
                
                if not severity:
                    severity = res.get('properties', {}).get('cvssv3_severity')
                
                if not severity:
                    severity = rule.get('properties', {}).get('cvssv3_severity')

                if not severity:
                    cvss = res.get('properties', {}).get('cvssv3_score') or rule.get('properties', {}).get('cvssv3_score')
                    if cvss:
                        try:
                            score = float(cvss)
                            if score >= 9.0: severity = 'CRITICAL'
                            elif score >= 7.0: severity = 'HIGH'
                            elif score >= 4.0: severity = 'MEDIUM'
                            else: severity = 'LOW'
                        except: pass
                
                if not severity:
                    level = res.get('level', 'warning').lower()
                    if level == 'error':
                        severity = 'HIGH'
                    elif level == 'warning':
                        severity = 'MEDIUM'
                    else:
                        severity = 'LOW'
                
                if severity:
                    s_char = severity.strip().upper()[0]
                    if s_char in counts:
                        counts[s_char] += 1
                    else:
                        if 'CRIT' in severity.upper(): counts['C'] += 1
                        elif 'HIGH' in severity.upper(): counts['H'] += 1
                        elif 'MED' in severity.upper(): counts['M'] += 1
                        elif 'LOW' in severity.upper(): counts['L'] += 1
    except:
        pass
    return counts

def get_detailed_vulns(img_name):
    """Returns detailed counts per tool with robust filename and JSON parsing."""
    safe_name_new = img_name.replace('/', '_').replace(':', '_').replace('@', '_')
    safe_name_old = img_name.replace('/', '_').replace(':', '_') # Keep old for backwards compatibility
    
    results = {
        'trivy': {'counts': {'C': 0, 'H': 0, 'M': 0, 'L': 0}, 'status': -1},
        'snyk': {'counts': {'C': 0, 'H': 0, 'M': 0, 'L': 0}, 'status': -1},
        'grype': {'counts': {'C': 0, 'H': 0, 'M': 0, 'L': 0}, 'status': -1},
        'docker_scout': {'counts': {'C': 0, 'H': 0, 'M': 0, 'L': 0}, 'status': -1},
        'syft': {'status': -1},
        'cosign': {'status': -1}
    }
    
    def find_file(prefix, suffix):
        for sn in [safe_name_new, safe_name_old]:
            p = os.path.join(raw_dir, f"{prefix}_{sn}{suffix}")
            if os.path.exists(p): return p
        return None

    # 1. Trivy
    path = find_file("trivy", ".json")
    if path:
        results['trivy']['status'] = 0
        try:
            with open(path, 'r') as f:
                data = json.load(f)
                for res in data.get('Results', []):
                    for v in res.get('Vulnerabilities', []):
                        s = v.get('Severity', '').upper()[0]
                        if s in results['trivy']['counts']: results['trivy']['counts'][s] += 1
            if results['trivy']['counts']['C'] > 0: results['trivy']['status'] = 1
        except: pass

    # 2. Snyk
    path = find_file("snyk", ".json")
    if path:
        results['snyk']['status'] = 0
        try:
            with open(path, 'r') as f:
                data = json.load(f)
                vulns = data.get('vulnerabilities', []) if isinstance(data, dict) else []
                for v in vulns:
                    s = v.get('severity', '').upper()[0]
                    if s in results['snyk']['counts']: results['snyk']['counts'][s] += 1
            if results['snyk']['counts']['C'] > 0: results['snyk']['status'] = 1
        except: pass

    # 3. Grype
    path = find_file("grype", ".json")
    if path:
        results['grype']['status'] = 0
        try:
            with open(path, 'r') as f:
                data = json.load(f)
                for match in data.get('matches', []):
                    s = match.get('vulnerability', {}).get('severity', '').upper()[0]
                    if s in results['grype']['counts']: results['grype']['counts'][s] += 1
            if results['grype']['counts']['C'] > 0: results['grype']['status'] = 1
        except: pass

    # 3.5 Docker Scout (SARIF)
    path = find_file("docker_scout", "_cves.json")
    if path:
        results['docker_scout']['status'] = 0
        try:
            counts = parse_sarif_docker_scout(path)
            results['docker_scout']['counts'] = counts
            if counts['C'] > 0: results['docker_scout']['status'] = 1
        except: pass

    # 4. Syft (SBOM)
    path = find_file("sbom", ".spdx.json")
    if path: results['syft']['status'] = 0
    
    # 5. Cosign
    path = find_file("cosign", ".txt")
    if path:
        results['cosign']['status'] = 1
        with open(path, 'r') as f:
            if "verified" in f.read().lower(): results['cosign']['status'] = 0
            
    return results

def get_status_info(file):
    path = os.path.join(raw_dir, file)
    status_label = " Not Run"
    comment = ""
    if os.path.exists(path):
        try:
            with open(path, 'r') as f:
                data = json.load(f)
                status = data.get('status', 'unknown')
                if status == 'passed': status_label = "Passed"
                elif status == 'failed': status_label = "Failed"
                elif status == 'warning': status_label = "Warning"
                elif status == 'skipped': status_label = "Skipped"
                else: status_label = f"{status}"
                
                if file == 'nfcore_lint.json' and status == 'warning':
                    comment = "Custom pipeline config"
                elif file == 'reproducibility.json':
                    if status == 'failed' or status == 'warning':
                        has_hashes = data.get('container_hashes', False)
                        has_lock = data.get('nextflow_lock', False)
                        if not has_hashes: comment = "CRITICAL: Using mutable tags instead of SHA256 hashes"
                        elif not has_lock: comment = "Missing nextflow.lock file"
                    elif status == 'passed':
                        comment = "Strict reproducibility (hashes + lockfile)"
                elif file == 'nf_config_validation.json' and status == 'warning':
                    comment = "Deprecated Nextflow syntax found"
                elif file == 'bandit.json':
                    issues = data.get('issues', 0)
                    high = data.get('high', 0)
                    if status == 'passed': comment = "No security issues found in Python code"
                    elif status == 'warning': comment = f"Found {issues} issues ({high} high severity)"
                    elif status == 'failed': comment = f"Found {high} HIGH severity Python vulnerabilities"
                elif file == 'flake8.json':
                    issues = data.get('issues', 0)
                    if status == 'passed': comment = "Python code adheres to PEP 8 standards"
                    elif status == 'warning': comment = f"Found {issues} code quality / styling issues"
                elif file == 'gitleaks.json':
                    gitleaks_path = os.path.join(raw_dir, "gitleaks_findings.json")
                    if os.path.exists(gitleaks_path):
                        with open(gitleaks_path, 'r') as f:
                            raw_findings = json.load(f)
                            seen = set()
                            findings = []
                            binary_or_report_exts = ('.png', '.jpg', '.jpeg', '.gif', '.pdf', '.zip', '.tar', '.gz', '.bam', '.sam', '.bai', '.fastq', '.fq', '.vcf', '.qmd', '.html', '.css', '.svg', '.webp', '.lock')
                            for r in raw_findings:
                                filepath = r.get('File', '')
                                if filepath.lower().endswith(binary_or_report_exts) or 'reports/' in filepath or 'report-check/' in filepath or '.git/' in filepath or 'docs/' in filepath or 'site/' in filepath or 'containers/docker/' in filepath:
                                    continue
                                key = (filepath, r.get('StartLine', ''), r.get('RuleID', ''))
                                if key not in seen:
                                    seen.add(key)
                                    findings.append(r)
                            leaks = len(findings)
                            if leaks == 0:
                                status_label = 'Passed'
                                comment = "No active hardcoded credentials or API keys found"
                            else:
                                status_label = 'Failed'
                                comment = f"CRITICAL: Found {leaks} active hardcoded secrets!"
                    else:
                        if status == 'passed':
                            status_label = 'Passed'
                            comment = "No hardcoded credentials or API keys found"
                        elif status == 'failed':
                            status_label = 'Failed'
                            comment = "CRITICAL: Found hardcoded secrets!"
                elif file == 'r_audit.json':
                    issues = data.get('issues', 0)
                    if status == 'passed': comment = "No unsafe R evals/system calls or vulnerable packages"
                    elif status == 'warning': comment = f"Found {issues} unsafe R patterns or dependencies"
                elif file == 'black.json':
                    unformatted = data.get('unformatted_files', 0)
                    if status == 'passed': comment = "All Python files are deterministically formatted"
                    elif status == 'warning': comment = f"Found {unformatted} unformatted Python files"
                    elif status == 'skipped': comment = data.get('reason', 'Skipped')
                
                if 'reason' in data and file != 'gitleaks.json' and file != 'black.json':
                    comment = data['reason']
                    
        except (json.JSONDecodeError, Exception):
            status_label = "Skipped"
            comment = "Error reading output"
    return status_label, comment
```

```{python}
import datetime

# --- PERFORM ALL COMPLIANCE CALCULATIONS ---
# Load images list
images = []
images_file = os.path.join(raw_dir, "images.txt")
if os.path.exists(images_file):
    try:
        with open(images_file, 'r') as f:
            images = [line.strip() for line in f if line.strip()]
    except: pass
if not images and os.path.exists(raw_dir):
    try:
        for f in os.listdir(raw_dir):
            if f.startswith("trivy_") and f.endswith(".json"):
                img_part = f[6:-5]
                if img_part not in images:
                    images.append(img_part)
    except: pass

trivy_status, snyk_status, grype_status, scout_status, syft_status, cosign_status = "Not Run", "Not Run", "Not Run", "Not Run", "Not Run", "Not Run"
trivy_comment, snyk_comment, grype_comment, scout_comment, syft_comment, cosign_comment = "", "", "", "", "", ""

if images:
    trivy_fails = snyk_fails = grype_fails = scout_fails = syft_fails = cosign_fails = 0
    trivy_scanned = snyk_scanned = grype_scanned = scout_scanned = syft_scanned = cosign_scanned = 0
    trivy_crits = snyk_crits = grype_crits = scout_crits = 0
    
    for img in images:
        res = get_detailed_vulns(img)
        if res['trivy']['status'] != -1:
            trivy_scanned += 1
            if res['trivy']['status'] == 1: trivy_fails += 1
            trivy_crits += res['trivy']['counts']['C']
        if res['snyk']['status'] != -1:
            snyk_scanned += 1
            if res['snyk']['status'] == 1: snyk_fails += 1
            snyk_crits += res['snyk']['counts']['C']
        if res['grype']['status'] != -1:
            grype_scanned += 1
            if res['grype']['status'] == 1: grype_fails += 1
            grype_crits += res['grype']['counts']['C']
        if res['docker_scout']['status'] != -1:
            scout_scanned += 1
            if res['docker_scout']['status'] == 1: scout_fails += 1
            scout_crits += res['docker_scout']['counts']['C']
        if res['syft']['status'] != -1:
            syft_scanned += 1
            if res['syft']['status'] == 1: syft_fails += 1
        if res['cosign']['status'] != -1:
            cosign_scanned += 1
            if res['cosign']['status'] == 1: cosign_fails += 1

    if trivy_scanned > 0:
        trivy_status = "Failed" if trivy_fails > 0 else "Passed"
        trivy_comment = f"Scanned {trivy_scanned} images. Found {trivy_crits} Critical CVEs." if trivy_crits > 0 else f"Scanned {trivy_scanned} images. All clean."
    if snyk_scanned > 0:
        snyk_status = "Failed" if snyk_fails > 0 else "Passed"
        snyk_comment = f"Scanned {snyk_scanned} images. Found {snyk_crits} Critical CVEs." if snyk_crits > 0 else f"Scanned {snyk_scanned} images. All clean."
    if grype_scanned > 0:
        grype_status = "Failed" if grype_fails > 0 else "Passed"
        grype_comment = f"Scanned {grype_scanned} images. Found {grype_crits} Critical CVEs." if grype_crits > 0 else f"Scanned {grype_scanned} images. All clean."
    if scout_scanned > 0:
        scout_status = "Failed" if scout_fails > 0 else "Passed"
        scout_comment = f"Scanned {scout_scanned} images. Found {scout_crits} Critical CVEs." if scout_crits > 0 else f"Scanned {scout_scanned} images. All clean."
    if syft_scanned > 0:
        syft_status = "Failed" if syft_fails > 0 else "Passed"
        syft_comment = f"SBOMs generated for {syft_scanned} images." if syft_fails == 0 else f"SBOM failed for {syft_fails}/{syft_scanned} images."
    if cosign_scanned > 0:
        cosign_status = "Failed" if cosign_fails > 0 else "Passed"
        cosign_comment = f"All {cosign_scanned} signatures verified." if cosign_fails == 0 else f"Failed verification for {cosign_fails}/{cosign_scanned} images."

# Snyk skip overrides
snyk_json_path = os.path.join(raw_dir, "snyk.json")
if os.path.exists(snyk_json_path):
    try:
        with open(snyk_json_path, 'r') as f:
            s_data = json.load(f)
            if s_data.get('status') == 'skipped':
                snyk_status = "Skipped"
                snyk_comment = s_data.get('reason', 'Disabled by user')
    except: pass

r_path = os.path.join(raw_dir, "r_audit_raw.json")
lintr_status = "Not Run"
lintr_comment = ""
oyster_status = "Not Run"
oyster_comment = ""
riskmetric_status = "Not Run"
riskmetric_comment = ""

if os.path.exists(r_path):
    try:
        with open(r_path, 'r') as f:
            r_data = json.load(f)
            linters = r_data.get('linters', [])
            lint_count = len(linters) if isinstance(linters, list) else r_data.get('lint_count', 0)
            lintr_status = "Passed" if lint_count == 0 else "Warning"
            lintr_comment = f"Found {lint_count} code quality / style warnings." if lint_count > 0 else "No R style or dangerous patterns found."
            
            vulns = r_data.get('vulnerabilities', [])
            vuln_count = len(vulns) if isinstance(vulns, list) else r_data.get('vuln_count', 0)
            oyster_status = "Passed" if vuln_count == 0 else "Failed"
            oyster_comment = f"Found {vuln_count} vulnerable R dependencies." if vuln_count > 0 else "No vulnerable R dependencies detected."
            
            risks = r_data.get('risks', [])
            risk_count = len(risks) if isinstance(risks, list) else 0
            riskmetric_status = "Passed" if risk_count == 0 else "Warning"
            riskmetric_comment = f"Found {risk_count} low quality / risk R packages." if risk_count > 0 else "All R packages pass maintenance score validation."
    except: pass

r_json_path = os.path.join(raw_dir, "r_audit.json")
if os.path.exists(r_json_path):
    try:
        with open(r_json_path, 'r') as f:
            r_data = json.load(f)
            if r_data.get('status') == 'skipped':
                lintr_status = oyster_status = riskmetric_status = "Skipped"
                lintr_comment = oyster_comment = riskmetric_comment = r_data.get('reason', 'No R files found')
    except: pass

has_r_manifest = os.path.exists("/target/renv.lock") or os.path.exists("/target/DESCRIPTION")
if not has_r_manifest and lintr_status not in ["Skipped", "Not Run"]:
    oyster_status = "Skipped"
    oyster_comment = "Skipped: no renv.lock or DESCRIPTION file found"
    riskmetric_status = "Skipped"
    riskmetric_comment = "Skipped: no renv.lock or DESCRIPTION file found"

gitleaks_status, gitleaks_comment = get_status_info("gitleaks.json")
semgrep_status, semgrep_comment = get_status_info("semgrep.json")
bandit_status, bandit_comment = get_status_info("bandit.json")
flake8_status, flake8_comment = get_status_info("flake8.json")
black_status, black_comment = get_status_info("black.json")
nfcore_status, nfcore_comment = get_status_info("nfcore_lint.json")
nf_config_status, nf_config_comment = get_status_info("nf_config_validation.json")
reproducibility_status, reproducibility_comment = get_status_info("reproducibility.json")

# Define tools by Clinical Domain
domain_tools = {
    'A': [
        ('Trivy', trivy_status, trivy_comment),
        ('Snyk', snyk_status, snyk_comment),
        ('Docker Scout', scout_status, scout_comment),
        ('Syft', syft_status, syft_comment),
        ('Grype', grype_status, grype_comment),
        ('Cosign', cosign_status, cosign_comment)
    ],
    'B': [
        ('Reproducibility Gate', reproducibility_status, reproducibility_comment),
        ('Nextflow Config Validation', nf_config_status, nf_config_comment),
        ('nf-core lint', nfcore_status, nfcore_comment)
    ],
    'C': [
        ('Semgrep', semgrep_status, semgrep_comment),
        ('Bandit', bandit_status, bandit_comment),
        ('Flake8', flake8_status, flake8_comment),
        ('Black', black_status, black_comment),
        ('R lintr', lintr_status, lintr_comment),
        ('R oysteR', oyster_status, oyster_comment),
        ('R riskmetric', riskmetric_status, riskmetric_comment)
    ],
    'D': [
        ('Gitleaks', gitleaks_status, gitleaks_comment)
    ]
}

failed_per_domain = {dom: [name for name, stat, comm in domain_tools[dom] if stat == 'Failed'] for dom in ['A', 'B', 'C', 'D']}
total_failed_tools = sum(len(fails) for fails in failed_per_domain.values())
failed_domains_count = sum(1 for fails in failed_per_domain.values() if len(fails) > 0)
skipped_tools_list = [name for dom in ['A', 'B', 'C', 'D'] for name, stat, comm in domain_tools[dom] if stat == 'Skipped']
warned_tools_list = [name for dom in ['A', 'B', 'C', 'D'] for name, stat, comm in domain_tools[dom] if stat == 'Warning']

# 4-Level Evaluation Engine
# 1. FAILED / BLOCKED: > 2 tools failed from >= 2 domains
if total_failed_tools > 2 and failed_domains_count >= 2:
    compliance_level = "FAILED / BLOCKED"
    compliance_emoji = "🔴"
    compliance_impact = "Immediate Pipeline Suspension. Disallowed for patient diagnostics under CAP/CLIA guidelines."
    compliance_class = "failed"
    compliance_color = "#721c24"
    compliance_back = "#f8d7da"
    compliance_border = "#f5c6cb"
    ltx_back = "red!5!white"
    ltx_frame = "red!75!black"
# 2. WARNING: > 1 tools failed from > 1 domains, OR exactly 2 tools failed in 1 domain
elif (total_failed_tools > 1 and failed_domains_count > 1) or any(len(fails) >= 2 for fails in failed_per_domain.values()):
    compliance_level = "WARNING"
    compliance_emoji = "🟠"
    compliance_impact = "Systemic Deficiencies / Concentrated Quality Risks. Requires URGENT REVIEW and remediation before re-validation."
    compliance_class = "warning"
    compliance_color = "#c2410c"
    compliance_back = "#fff7ed"
    compliance_border = "#ea580c"
    ltx_back = "orange!5!white"
    ltx_frame = "orange!80!black"
# 3. APPROVED WITH LIMITATIONS: Exactly 1 tool failed in any domain, all other domains pass
elif total_failed_tools == 1:
    compliance_level = "APPROVED WITH LIMITATIONS"
    compliance_emoji = "🟡"
    compliance_impact = "Conditional Clinical Use Allowed. Requires a documented 30-day Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) plan for the isolated failure."
    compliance_class = "warning"
    compliance_color = "#856404"
    compliance_back = "#fff3cd"
    compliance_border = "#ffeeba"
    ltx_back = "yellow!5!white"
    ltx_frame = "yellow!60!orange"
# 4. APPROVED: 0 failed tools (warnings/skips allowed)
else:
    compliance_level = "APPROVED"
    compliance_emoji = "🟢"
    compliance_impact = "Full Clinical Certification. The pipeline satisfies core security validation gates and is certified for routine variant diagnostics."
    compliance_class = "passed"
    compliance_color = "#155724"
    compliance_back = "#d4edda"
    compliance_border = "#c3e6cb"
    ltx_back = "green!5!white"
    ltx_frame = "green!60!black"

# Check for Domain Incompletion (if all tools in any domain are skipped or not run)
domain_unverified = False
for dom, tools in domain_tools.items():
    active_count = sum(1 for name, stat, comm in tools if stat in ['Passed', 'Failed', 'Warning'])
    if active_count == 0:
        domain_unverified = True

# --- SCIENTIFIC COMPLIANCE BYPASS OVERRIDES ---
# Get skipped counts per domain
skipped_per_domain = {dom: sum(1 for name, stat, comm in tools if stat == 'Skipped') for dom, tools in domain_tools.items()}
total_skipped_tools = len(skipped_tools_list)

bypass_override_failed = False
bypass_override_limitations = False
bypass_override_warning = False
bypass_override_reasons = []

# 1. Zero-Bypass Pillar: Secrets Auditing (Domain D)
if skipped_per_domain['D'] > 0:
    bypass_override_failed = True
    bypass_override_reasons.append("HIPAA compliance breach: Secrets and Credentials scanning (Gitleaks) bypassed.")

# 2. Domain B Reproducibility Bypass Limit (Max 1 skip allowed)
if skipped_per_domain['B'] > 1:
    bypass_override_limitations = True
    bypass_override_reasons.append(f"Reproducibility validation severely restricted ({skipped_per_domain['B']} skipped in Domain B).")

# 3. Domain A Supply Chain Bypass Limit (Max 2 skips allowed)
if skipped_per_domain['A'] > 2:
    bypass_override_limitations = True
    bypass_override_reasons.append(f"Supply Chain validation severely restricted ({skipped_per_domain['A']} skipped in Domain A).")

# 4. Domain C Code SAST Bypass Limit (Max 2 skips allowed)
if skipped_per_domain['C'] > 2:
    bypass_override_limitations = True
    bypass_override_reasons.append(f"Static code integrity checks severely restricted ({skipped_per_domain['C']} skipped in Domain C).")

# 5. Entire Domain Unverified (Domain Completeness - 100% skipped in any domain)
if domain_unverified:
    bypass_override_failed = True
    bypass_override_reasons.append("Complete verification blank: One or more clinical domains have zero active checkers (100% skipped).")

# Apply Overrides (Capping at lower levels)
if bypass_override_failed:
    compliance_level = "FAILED / BLOCKED"
    compliance_emoji = "🔴"
    compliance_impact = "Immediate Pipeline Suspension. Disallowed for patient diagnostics under CAP/CLIA guidelines due to complete domain bypasses."
    compliance_class = "failed"
    compliance_color = "#721c24"
    compliance_back = "#f8d7da"
    compliance_border = "#f5c6cb"
    ltx_back = "red!5!white"
    ltx_frame = "red!75!black"
elif bypass_override_warning and compliance_level in ["APPROVED", "APPROVED WITH LIMITATIONS"]:
    compliance_level = "WARNING"
    compliance_emoji = "🟠"
    compliance_impact = "Systemic Verification Gaps. Bypassing critical controls prevents safe clinical approval."
    compliance_class = "warning"
    compliance_color = "#c2410c"
    compliance_back = "#fff7ed"
    compliance_border = "#ea580c"
    ltx_back = "orange!5!white"
    ltx_frame = "orange!80!black"
elif bypass_override_limitations and compliance_level == "APPROVED":
    compliance_level = "APPROVED WITH LIMITATIONS"
    compliance_emoji = "🟡"
    compliance_impact = "Conditional Clinical Use Allowed. Restricting quality gates (e.g. domain bypasses) limits clinical accreditation."
    compliance_class = "warning"
    compliance_color = "#856404"
    compliance_back = "#fff3cd"
    compliance_border = "#ffeeba"
    ltx_back = "yellow!5!white"
    ltx_frame = "yellow!60!orange"

# Construct Actionable Deficiencies list
caveats = []
if compliance_level == "FAILED / BLOCKED":
    for dom, fails in failed_per_domain.items():
        if fails:
            caveats.append(f"Domain {dom} critical failure: {', '.join(fails)}")
elif compliance_level == "WARNING":
    for dom, fails in failed_per_domain.items():
        if fails:
            caveats.append(f"Systemic failure in Domain {dom}: {', '.join(fails)}")
elif compliance_level == "APPROVED WITH LIMITATIONS":
    for dom, fails in failed_per_domain.items():
        if fails:
            caveats.append(f"Isolated failure in Domain {dom}: {fails[0]} failed. Requires a standard CAPA record.")

# Add specific bypass/override reasons to caveats
for reason in bypass_override_reasons:
    caveats.append(f"Verification Constraint: {reason}")

if skipped_tools_list:
    non_critical_skips = [t for t in skipped_tools_list if not any(r.endswith(t) for r in bypass_override_reasons)]
    if non_critical_skips:
        caveats.append(f"Other skipped checks: {', '.join(non_critical_skips)}")
if warned_tools_list:
    caveats.append(f"Linting / Style Quality warnings (Non-critical): {', '.join(warned_tools_list)}")

# Load metadata
metadata_path = os.path.join(raw_dir, "metadata.json")
meta_name = os.environ.get('PIPELINE_NAME', 'quindecagon')
meta_path = 'N/A'
meta_command = 'N/A'
if os.path.exists(metadata_path):
    try:
        with open(metadata_path, 'r') as f:
            mdata = json.load(f)
            meta_name = mdata.get('pipeline_name', meta_name)
            meta_path = mdata.get('pipeline_path', 'N/A')
            meta_command = mdata.get('run_command', 'N/A')
    except Exception:
        pass

timestamp = datetime.datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")

print(f"# quindecagon: Clinical Pipeline Integrity & Security Report {{.unnumbered}}\n")
print("This report presents the clinical validation results compiled by the **quindecagon** Clinical Pipeline Integrity & Security Framework (v0.4.0). quindecagon employs a comprehensive, 'defense-in-depth' architecture synthesizing outputs from 15 specialized security, quality-assurance, and supply-chain auditing instruments. Designed specifically for molecular diagnostics and CAP/CLIA/HIPAA-regulated bioinformatics environments, this automated audit eliminates container tag drift, detects static code vulnerabilities, identifies hardcoded secrets, and mathematically guarantees the end-to-end reproducibility of clinical pipelines.\n")

if fmt in ['latex', 'pdf']:
    print(f"**Report Formats**: [Open Interactive HTML Cockpit Dashboard (report.html)](report.html) | [View Clinical PDF Certificate (report.pdf)](report.pdf)\n")
else:
    print(f"**Report Formats**: [💻 Open Interactive HTML Cockpit Dashboard](report.html) | [📄 View Clinical PDF Certificate](report.pdf)\n")

# --- RENDER ACCREDITATION BOX ---
fmt = os.environ.get('QUARTO_FORMAT', 'html')
if fmt in ['latex', 'pdf']:
    print(f"\\begin{{tcolorbox}}[colback={ltx_back},colframe={ltx_frame},arc=2mm,title=\\textbf{{{compliance_level} - Clinical Certification Status}}]")
    print(f"\\textbf{{Clinical Compliance Level}}: {compliance_level}\\\\")

    print(f"\\textbf{{Regulatory Reference}}: Evaluated under the College of American Pathologists (CAP) Molecular Pathology NGS checklist items \\textbf{{MOM.36000}} (Pipeline Validation), \\textbf{{MOM.36150}} (Security Integrity), \\textbf{{MOM.36200}} (Provenance Validation), and \\textbf{{ISO 15189:2022 \\S7.4}} guidelines for bioinformatics software validation.\\\\")
    if caveats:
        print("\\textbf{Actionable Audit Caveats \\& Deficiencies}:")
        print("\\begin{itemize}")
        for cav in caveats:
            # Escape LaTeX symbols safely
            esc_cav = cav.replace('%', '\\%').replace('_', '\\_').replace('&', '\\&').replace('$', '\\$')
            print(f"\\item {esc_cav}")
        print("\\end{itemize}")
    print("\\end{tcolorbox}\n")
else:
    print(f'<div class="status-box status-{compliance_class}" style="border: 2px solid {compliance_border}; padding: 1.5em; border-radius: 8px; margin-bottom: 1.5em; background-color: {compliance_back}; color: {compliance_color};">')
    print(f'<h3 style="margin-top: 0; font-weight: bold; font-size: 1.25em; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5em;">{compliance_emoji} {compliance_level} - Clinical Certification</h3>')
    print(f'<p><strong>Clinical Compliance Level:</strong> {compliance_level}</p>')

    print(f'<p><strong>Regulatory Reference:</strong> Evaluated under the College of American Pathologists (CAP) Molecular Pathology NGS checklist items <strong>MOM.36000</strong> (Pipeline Validation), <strong>MOM.36150</strong> (Security Integrity), <strong>MOM.36200</strong> (Provenance Validation), and <strong>ISO 15189:2022 §7.4</strong> guidelines for bioinformatics software validation.</p>')
    if caveats:
        print('<p><strong>Actionable Audit Caveats & Deficiencies:</strong></p>')
```

| **Static Code SAST** | Semgrep & Bandit Script Auditing | **MOM.36050** (Software Code Integrity & Development Validation) | **§164.308 (a)(8)** (Technical Security Evaluation) | Discovers command-injection flaws and insecure APIs in custom helper scripts before clinical runs. |
| **R Dependency Auditing** | oysteR Dependency Vulnerability Auditing | **MOM.36120** (Third-party Library & Package Vulnerability Tracking) | **§164.308 (a)(1)(ii)(B)** (Risk Mitigation & Control Implementation) | Cross-references third-party R/CRAN libraries against the Sonatype OSS Index to prevent dependency-chain hijacks. |

```{python}
#| echo: false
```

```{python}
# Load image list from file OR auto-discover from scan files in raw/
images = []
images_file = os.path.join(raw_dir, "images.txt")
if os.path.exists(images_file):
    with open(images_file, 'r') as f:
        images = [line.strip() for line in f if line.strip()]

# Backup: if images.txt is empty/missing, look at raw files
if not images:
    for f in os.listdir(raw_dir):
        if f.startswith("trivy_") and f.endswith(".json"):
            # Extract image name: trivy_<SAFE_NAME>.json
            img_part = f[6:-5]
            if img_part not in images:
                images.append(img_part)

if images:
    for img in sorted(images):
        if '@sha256:' in img:
            name, sha = img.split('@sha256:')
            print(f"* **{name}**\n    - `sha256:{sha}`")
        else:
            print(f"* `{img}`")
else:
    print("**[WARN] No container images discovered.**")
```

```{python}
        # 0 fails = Passed, >= 3 fails = Failed, 1 or 2 = Warning
        fails = 0
        for tool in ['trivy', 'snyk', 'grype', 'docker_scout', 'syft', 'cosign']:
            if res[tool]['status'] == 1: fails += 1
        
        if fails == 0: 
            status = "Passed"
        elif fails >= 3:
            status = "Failed"
        else:
            status = "Warning"

        # Format Tool Columns
        def fmt_vuln(tool_res):
            if tool_res['status'] == -1: return "-"
            c = tool_res['counts']
            if c['C'] == 0: return f"Clean (H:{c['H']})"
            return f"<b>Crit:{c['C']}</b> (H:{c['H']})"

        t_col = fmt_vuln(res['trivy'])
        s_col = fmt_vuln(res['snyk'])
        g_col = fmt_vuln(res['grype'])
        scout_col = fmt_vuln(res['docker_scout'])
        
        # Syft and Cosign are binary pass/fail
        def fmt_binary(val):
            if val == -1: return "-"
            return "Yes" if val == 0 else "No"
            
        y_col = fmt_binary(res['syft']['status'])
        c_col = fmt_binary(res['cosign']['status'])

        # Final aggregate comment
        total_crit = res['trivy']['counts']['C'] + res['snyk']['counts']['C'] + res['grype']['counts']['C'] + res['docker_scout']['counts']['C']
        comment = "Verified safe" if fails == 0 else f"{fails}/6 checks failed"
        if total_crit > 0: comment = f"{total_crit} Criticals found"

        fmt = os.environ.get('QUARTO_FORMAT', 'html')
        if fmt in ['latex', 'pdf']:
            table_lines.append(f"| `\\texttt{{{display_name_short}}}`{{=latex}} | {fmt_status(status)} | {t_col} | {s_col} | {g_col} | {scout_col} | {y_col} | {c_col} | {comment} |")
        else:
            table_lines.append(f"| `{display_name_short}` | {fmt_status(status)} | {t_col} | {s_col} | {g_col} | {scout_col} | {y_col} | {c_col} | {comment} |")

    table_lines.append("\n: Container Security Consensus {tbl-colwidths=\"[22, 8, 10, 10, 10, 10, 6, 6, 18]\"}\n")
    print("\n".join(table_lines))
```

# Script Security and Code Quality

## Nextflow Linting (nf-core)

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
nfcore_path = os.path.join(raw_dir, "nfcore_lint.json")
if os.path.exists(nfcore_path):
    try:
        with open(nfcore_path, 'r') as f:
            nf_data = json.load(f)
            status = nf_data.get('status', 'unknown')
            reason = nf_data.get('reason', '')
            
            if reason:
                # If reason is present, display it in a tcolorbox note style or markdown callout
                print("::: {.callout-note}\n")
                print(f"### Nextflow Linting Note / Warning\n")
                print(f"{reason}\n")
                print(":::\n")
            else:
                passed = nf_data.get('passed', [])
                warned = nf_data.get('warned', [])
                failed = nf_data.get('failed', [])
                
                passed_cnt = len(passed)
                warned_cnt = len(warned)
                failed_cnt = len(failed)
                
                print(f"**Nextflow linting (nf-core) completed with status: `{status.upper()}`.**\n")
                print(f"- **Passed Rules:** {passed_cnt}\n")
                print(f"- **Warned Rules:** {warned_cnt}\n")
                print(f"- **Failed Rules:** {failed_cnt}\n")
                
                findings = []
                for item in failed:
                    rule = "N/A"
                    msg = ""
                    if isinstance(item, dict):
                        rule = item.get('rule', 'N/A')
                        msg = item.get('message', '')
                    elif isinstance(item, (list, tuple)) and len(item) >= 2:
                        rule = item[0]
                        msg = item[1]
                    elif isinstance(item, str):
                        rule = item
                        msg = "Rule failed."
                    else:
                        rule = str(item)
                    findings.append(("FAIL", rule, msg))
                    
                for item in warned:
                    rule = "N/A"
                    msg = ""
                    if isinstance(item, dict):
                        rule = item.get('rule', 'N/A')
                        msg = item.get('message', '')
                    elif isinstance(item, (list, tuple)) and len(item) >= 2:
                        rule = item[0]
                        msg = item[1]
                    elif isinstance(item, str):
                        rule = item
                        msg = "Rule warned."
                    else:
                        rule = str(item)
                    findings.append(("WARN", rule, msg))
                
                if findings:
                    print("| Status | Rule | Message |")
                    print("| :--- | :--- | :--- |")
                    for status_type, rule, msg in findings[:10]:
                        if isinstance(msg, list):
                            msg_str = " ".join([str(x) for x in msg])
                        else:
                            msg_str = str(msg)
                        msg_str = msg_str.replace('\n', ' ')
                        print(f"| `{status_type}` | **{rule}** | {msg_str} |")
                    print("\n: Detailed nf-core lint findings {tbl-colwidths=\"[15, 25, 60]\"}\n")
                    if len(findings) > 10: print(f"*Note: Showing top 10 of {len(findings)} issues. [View full list in raw/nfcore_lint.json]*\n")
                else:
                    print("**[PASS] No warned or failed nf-core lint rules found.**\n")
                    
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"**[WARN] Error parsing nf-core lint results: {e}**\n")
else:
    print("**[INFO] nf-core lint check not run.**\n")
```

```{python}
                        if code in critical_codes or code.startswith('E9') or code.startswith('F8'):
                            critical_items.append((base_fname, item))

                        col = item.get('column_number', '')

                else:

    except Exception as e:

else:
```

## Hardcoded Secrets Detection (Gitleaks)

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
gitleaks_path = os.path.join(raw_dir, "gitleaks_findings.json")
if os.path.exists(gitleaks_path):
    try:
        with open(gitleaks_path, 'r') as f:
            raw_findings = json.load(f)
            if not raw_findings:
                print("**[PASS] No hardcoded secrets, API keys, or private tokens found.**\n")
            else:
                seen = set()
                findings = []
                binary_or_report_exts = (
                    '.png', '.jpg', '.jpeg', '.gif', '.pdf', '.zip', '.tar', '.gz', 
                    '.bam', '.sam', '.bai', '.fastq', '.fq', '.vcf', '.qmd', 
                    '.html', '.css', '.svg', '.webp', '.lock'
                )
                for r in raw_findings:
                    filepath = r.get('File', '')
                    # Filter out binary files, logs, config cache, docs, and reports
                    if filepath.lower().endswith(binary_or_report_exts) or 'reports/' in filepath or 'report-check/' in filepath or '.git/' in filepath or 'docs/' in filepath or 'site/' in filepath or 'containers/docker/' in filepath:
                        continue
                    
                    line = r.get('StartLine', '')
                    rule = r.get('RuleID', '')
                    # Deduplicate: Only report the leak once per file, line, and rule ID
                    key = (filepath, line, rule)
                    if key not in seen:
                        seen.add(key)
                        findings.append(r)
                
                if not findings:
                    print("**[PASS] No active hardcoded secrets, API keys, or private tokens found (excluding binary assets and scan reports).**\n")
                else:
                    print(f"**[FAIL] Gitleaks identified {len(findings)} unique active secrets:**\n")
                    print("| File | Line | Rule | Secret Type | Secret / Match (Redacted) |")
                    print("| :--- | :---: | :---: | :--- | :--- |")
                    for r in findings[:10]:
                        fname = format_word_breaks(os.path.basename(r.get('File', '')), is_code=False)
                        line = r.get('StartLine', '')
                        rule = r.get('RuleID', '')
                        # Prevent pipe characters in raw match/desc from breaking the Markdown table
                        desc = r.get('Description', '').replace('\n', ' ').replace('|', '\\|')
                        
                        # Fetch the match or secret and safely redact it
                        secret_val = r.get('Secret', '') or r.get('Match', '') or 'REDACTED'
                        # Standardize to a safe string and escape pipes
                        secret = str(secret_val).replace('\n', ' ').replace('|', '\\|')
                        if len(secret) > 40:
                            secret = secret[:37] + "..."
                        
                        fmt = os.environ.get('QUARTO_FORMAT', 'html')
                        if fmt in ['latex', 'pdf']:
                            print(f"| `\\texttt{{{fname}}}`{{=latex}} | {line} | `\\texttt{{{rule}}}`{{=latex}} | {desc} | `\\texttt{{{secret}}}`{{=latex}} |")
                        else:
                            print(f"| `{fname}` | {line} | `{rule}` | {desc} | `{secret}` |")
                    print("\n: Gitleaks Findings {tbl-colwidths=\"[20, 10, 20, 30, 20]\"}\n")
                    if len(findings) > 10: print(f"*Note: Showing top 10 of {len(findings)} issues. [View full list in raw/gitleaks_findings.json]*\n")
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"**[WARN] Error reading Gitleaks findings: {e}**\n")
else:
    main_path = os.path.join(raw_dir, "gitleaks.json")
    if os.path.exists(main_path):
        print("**[PASS] No hardcoded secrets, API keys, or private tokens found.**\n")
    else:
        print("**[INFO] Gitleaks check not run or not available.**\n")
```

```{python}
    print(":::\n")

                    print("| File | Line | Type | Linter | Technical Details |")

                    for item in l_items[:10]:

                        else:

                    print("\n: R lintr Findings {tbl-colwidths=\"[25, 10, 10, 20, 35]\"}\n")
                    if len(l_items) > 10: print(f"*Note: Showing top 10 of {len(l_items)} issues. [View full list in raw/r_audit_raw.json]*\n")
                
                if vulns:
                    print("### Vulnerable R Dependencies (oysteR)\n")
                    print("| Package | Version | Vulnerability | Severity | Description |")
                    print("| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |")
                    v_items = vulns if isinstance(vulns, list) else [dict(zip(vulns, t)) for t in zip(*vulns.values())]
                    for v in v_items[:10]:
                        pkg = v.get('package', '')
                        ver = v.get('version', '')
                        title = v.get('title', v.get('id', ''))
                        cvss = v.get('cvssScore', '')
                        desc = v.get('description', '').replace('\n', ' ')
                        if len(desc) > 80: desc = desc[:77] + "..."
                        print(f"| **{pkg}** | `{ver}` | {title} | **{cvss}** | {desc} |")
                    print("\n: R oysteR Findings {tbl-colwidths=\"[20, 15, 20, 15, 30]\"}\n")
                    if len(v_items) > 10: print(f"*Note: Showing top 10 of {len(v_items)} issues. [View full list in raw/r_audit_raw.json]*\n")
                
                risks = r_data.get('risks', [])
                if risks:

                    print("| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |")
                    r_items = risks if isinstance(risks, list) else [dict(zip(risks, t)) for t in zip(*risks.values())]
                    for rk in r_items[:10]:
                        pkg = rk.get('package', '')
                        ver = rk.get('version', '')
                        score = rk.get('pkg_score', '')
                        try:
                            f_score = float(score)
                            status_desc = "⚠️ High Risk" if f_score < 0.5 else "✅ Safe"
                        except (ValueError, TypeError):
                            status_desc = "Unknown"
                        print(f"| **{pkg}** | `{ver}` | **{score}** | {status_desc} |")
                    print("\n: R riskmetric Quality Assessment {tbl-colwidths=\"[30, 25, 25, 20]\"}\n")
                    if len(r_items) > 10: print(f"*Note: Showing top 10 of {len(r_items)} issues. [View full list in raw/r_audit_raw.json]*\n")
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"**[WARN] Error reading R audit results: {e}**\n")
else:
    print("**[INFO] No R files scanned or R audit check not run.**\n")
```

## Cryptographic Provenance (Cosign)

```{python}
#| echo: false

cosign_path = os.path.join(raw_dir, "cosign.json")
if os.path.exists(cosign_path):
    try:
        with open(cosign_path, 'r') as f:
            c_data = json.load(f)
            status = c_data.get('status', 'unknown')
            if status == 'passed':
                print("**[PASS] All containers successfully verified against cryptographic signatures.**\n")
            else:
                print(f"**[{status.upper()}] Container signature verification failed or warnings found.**\n")
                print("For signature payloads, refer to `raw/cosign_*.txt`\n")
    except:
        print("**[INFO] Cosign verification status unknown.**\n")
else:
    print("**[INFO] Cosign provenance check skipped or not available.**\n")
```

# Audit Methodology & Clinical Security Reference

The security audit employs a **defense-in-depth** strategy, combining container vulnerability scans, software supply chain verification, and static code quality/security analysis of bioinformatic scripts. To provide laboratory directors and regulatory auditors with a definitive clinical reference, the pipeline's security controls are mapped against official clinical laboratory standards and regulatory requirements.

## Key Clinical Summary for Laboratory Directors

**quindecagon** is exceptionally strong because it **combines domain-specific bioinformatics checks (Nextflow configuration validations, R Bioconductor package vulnerability checks, and strict tag-reproducibility gates) with enterprise-grade supply-chain security (Syft SBOM, Cosign signatures, and Snyk/Trivy consensus).** 

Generic enterprise systems are completely blind to Nextflow/R ecosystems and cannot guarantee the strict reproducibility (`nextflow.lock`) required for clinical diagnostics!

# Clinical Compliance & Regulatory References

This framework and its security matrix map directly to the following official clinical laboratory standards and regulatory requirements. We provide homepages and technical citations for reference:

1. **College of American Pathologists (CAP)**. Molecular Pathology NGS Checklist (MOM): [CAP Accreditation Checklists Website](https://www.cap.org/). Specifically items:
   - **MOM.36000**: NGS Pipeline Validation, Stability & Determinism.
   - **MOM.36050**: Software Code Integrity & Development Validation.
   - **MOM.36100**: Access Control and Data Isolation Policies.
   - **MOM.36120**: Third-party Library & Package Vulnerability Tracking.
   - **MOM.36150**: Validation of Software Updates & Security Integrity.
   - **MOM.36200**: Pipeline Component & Provenance Validation.
2. **Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) Security Rule**. 45 CFR Part 160 and Part 164 Subparts A and C: [HHS HIPAA Security Rule Guidance](https://www.hhs.gov/hipaa/for-professionals/security/laws-regulations/index.html). Specifically standards:
   - **§164.308 (a)(1)(ii)(A)**: Risk Analysis & Vulnerability Management.
   - **§164.308 (a)(1)(ii)(B)**: Risk Mitigation & Control Implementation.
   - **§164.308 (a)(4)**: Information Access Management.
   - **§164.308 (a)(8)**: Technical Security Evaluation.
   - **§164.312 (c)(1)**: Data Integrity Validation.
   - **§164.312 (e)(1)**: Transmission Security & Tamper Resistance.
3. **FDA Guidance on Medical Device Cybersecurity**. Cybersecurity in Medical Devices: Quality System Considerations and Content of Premarket Submissions: [FDA Cybersecurity Guidance](https://www.fda.gov/regulatory-information/search-fda-guidance-documents/cybersecurity-medical-devices-quality-system-considerations-and-content-premarket-submissions) (Mandates Software Bill of Materials / SBOM tracking for clinical-grade code assets).
4. **Clinical Accreditation Literature & Medical Laboratory Compliance Standards** (specifically CAP Accreditation Checklists and ISO 15189:2022 guidelines for bioinformatics software validation):
   - **Ellingford, J. M., et al. (2026).** *Best practice recommendations for bioinformatics approaches applied to high-throughput sequencing for rare disease and cancer diagnosis within the UK National Health Service*. Journal of Medical Genetics. [https://doi.org/10.1136/jmg-2025-111289](https://doi.org/10.1136/jmg-2025-111289)
   - **Lavrichenko, K., et al. (2024).** *Recommendations for bioinformatics in clinical practice*. Cold Spring Harbor Laboratory. [https://doi.org/10.1101/2024.11.23.624993](https://doi.org/10.1101/2024.11.23.624993)
   - **Ganzinger, M., et al. (2021).** *Biomedical and clinical research data management*. In Systems Medicine (pp. 532–543). Elsevier. [https://doi.org/10.1016/b978-0-12-801238-3.11621-6](https://doi.org/10.1016/b978-0-12-801238-3.11621-6)
   - **Vidanagamachchi, S. M., & Waidyarathna, K. M. G. T. R. (2024).** *Opportunities, challenges and future perspectives of using bioinformatics and artificial intelligence techniques on tropical disease identification using omics data*. Frontiers in Digital Health, 6. [https://doi.org/10.3389/fdgth.2024.1471200](https://doi.org/10.3389/fdgth.2024.1471200)
